sections.title: Game Hotfix Update
sections.description: This is a hotfix update targeting critical bugs. Replay codes from the June 24, 2025 patch are still available.

blocks.title: General
blocks.body: Fixed a bug with Wave Respawn from working correctly.

blocks.title: Heroes
blocks.body: Ana Fixed a bug affecting Biotic Rifle's Quick Scope Animation.

blocks.title: Stadium
blocks.body: D.Va Fixed a bug with Meka Punch. The power has been re-enabled Soldier: 76 Fixed a bug with Chaingun. The power has been re-enabled
